components.description: Central idea with branches — brainstorms, scope maps, onboarding topics. Radial spreads 3–8 branches around the centre; Tree reads left → right with leaves. Each branch keeps one categorical colour on its links. Built from Diagram/Node (Terminal = root, Process = branch) on a bg/sheet canvas. React: <MindMap root={{ label, children }} layout="radial | tree" />

Usage
Rules that keep the diagram readable.
One root, 3–8 branches; more → split into two maps.
One colour per branch, kept on every link of that branch.
Labels ≤ 3 words — the map is a summary, not a document.
Links never cross nodes; re-order branches instead.
Colour is a group, not a value
Branch colours only separate groups. Never use them to rank or score branches.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to React Flow, Mermaid, D3 or a native renderer.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Central idea with branches — Radial spreads 3–8 branches around the centre, Tree reads left → right with leaves.
Encoding
Position = hierarchy (centre or left = root), link colour = branch (categorical), node shape = role (Terminal root, Process branch).
Interaction
Hover branch → highlight. Click node → collapse / expand. Keyboard: arrows move between siblings, Enter opens, Escape collapses.
